incidents.title: Service Disruption on SG VPS 2 & SG VPS 4 (Host Node CPU Contention)
incidents.description: We observed severe performance degradation and intermittent unresponsiveness affecting the SG VPS 2 and SG VPS 4 instances. The issue was identified as sustained upstream hypervisor CPU contention (high CPU steal) on the host node infrastructure, resulting in dropped handshakes, socket backlogs, and connection timeouts. The hosting provider was engaged to migrate the affected virtual instances to healthy, uncongested host nodes. All network routing, services, and latency levels have since fully stabilized.

incidents.title: Service Disruption on SG3 VPN Servers (SSL & Domain Routing Issue)
incidents.description:
Date: August 20, 2026
Affected Services: SG VPS 3

Description:
We experienced a service disruption where the SG3 VPN servers became unresponsive and the primary domain failed to resolve properly. The root cause was traced to an SSL certificate renewal failure. This subsequently caused routing conflicts with the control panel domain originating from an external domain setup.

The SSL certificates have been manually corrected, and the domain routing has been restored to normal operation.

maintenance.title: V2Ray servers: address update (SG1 to SG6)
maintenance.description: We are moving the V2Ray servers SG1 to SG6 to a new address. Each server restarts once for a few seconds, so a connection may drop briefly; your app reconnects on its own. Your existing configs and usage links keep working, so there is nothing to change. Configs made after this use the new address.

maintenance.title: SG VPS 2 Server Upgrade & Migration
maintenance.description:
SG VPS 2 will undergo scheduled maintenance to migrate to higher-capacity hardware. During this window, services hosted on SG VPS 2 will experience temporary downtime.

Hardware Upgrades:

RAM: 6 GB → 16 GB

CPU: 4 Cores → 6 Cores

NVMe Storage: 100 GB → 200 GB

All active connections and services will automatically restore once the migration completes. Thank you for your patience.

maintenance.title: Server Maintainance
maintenance.description: Temporary downtime on SG-2 and SG-4. Our engineering team is currently performing unscheduled maintenance to restore services. Expected back online around 5:10 PM.
